newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ITT-Sheraton to manage SM project.
newsitem.headline: ITT-Sheraton to manage SM project.

text.p: SM Investments Corp, an unlisted affiliate of SM Development Corp, said on Wednesday it has signed an accord with ITT-Sheraton to manage its planned tourist resort in Tagaytay city, a prime tourist destination south of Manila.
This is the second contract of ITT-Sheraton with the SM group, a leader in the retail trade and the development of shopping malls in the Philippines.
The project, called Sheraton-SM Tagaytay Resort, is scheduled to open in 1999.
On Tuesday, SM Development Corp said its board had confirmed purchase of a 31,498 square metre lot in the hillside resort city of Tagaytay from SM Investment Corp.
